Name: Harvest Moon-Style Chickens
Author: SwordDays
Description:
[size=5]Overview[/size]

Chickens in Harvest Moon feed themselves when they're outside. Now chickens in Stardew Valley can do the same.

This mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url] to make it so chickens don't need to eat grass. Let them outside and they'll feed themselves. Just remember that they still need to eat, so if they can't go outside for any reason, you'll have to feed them yourself as usual.

[size=5]Install
[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Install Extra Animal Configs[/url]﻿.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods OR use the Mod Manager Download button.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Enjoy!
[/list]
